business: Northstar Industrial Supply, LLC (Specialty Industrial Distribution (fasteners & fluid power))

expectedRedFlags: Vendor rebate 'timing' normalization: Unsupported. The Q4-2025 rebate credit is an annual, recurring volume rebate booked in one month; adding it back double-counts recurring margin.
Obsolete inventory write-off: Largely unsupportable as one-time. Slow-moving stock builds every year; only ~$26,000 relates to a discontinued supplier line.
expectedYellowFlags: Above-market related-party warehouse rent: Partially supportable. Rent of $408,000/yr versus a $288,000/yr market rate supports a $120,000 add-back, not $168,000.
Owner compensation normalization: Supportable. Owner comp of $290,000 versus a $200,000 market GM cost; the $90,000 delta is documented and reasonable.
Customer concentration: Largest customer, Granite Medical Center, is 16.3% of FY2025 revenue; top 5 are 51.7%.

Seasonality and net working capital swing: FY2025 monthly EBITDA ranges from $-3,562 to $122,818; cash ranges from $18,670,470 to $27,144,095. The NWC peg must be set on a 12-month average, not a period-end snapshot.
groundTruth.notes: MML M&A Benchmark Deal DD-002: Northstar Industrial Supply, LLC (Specialty Industrial Distribution (fasteners & fluid power)). Seller claims $1.13M EBITDA vs $0.94M buyer-supported ($192k overstatement).
